The '''Tiger''' is an enemy in '''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]].'''

==='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''===
[[File:TigerNES1.png|80px]]

Introduced in [[Crystal Lake|Act 3-1]], Tigers are palette swaps of [[Dog]]s and do the same thing, quickly rushing at [[Ryu Hayabusa|Ryu]] from behind or ahead to put pressure on him and knock him aside. However, they only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.

==Trivia==
* In the original NES game, the enemy's design looked more like a leopard or a cheetah.
** However, in the PC Engine version, the design was changed to more closely resemble an actual tiger.
